caption:
Quick and Effortless - Snack Inspirations using  @boombayway’s signature sauces

Grilled Peanut + Lime Paneer Skewers
ingredients
100 grams paneer
1 -2 tbsp of @boombayway’s Peanut + Lime 
veggies of choice, I’ve used capsicum and onion here
1 tsp of @boombayway’s Five Chilli Oil, to cook 

Smoked Chilli + Jaggery Crunchy Chickpeas
ingredients
50 grams cooked chickpeas
2 tbsp of @boombayway’s Smoked Chilli + Jaggery 
2-3 tbsp rice flour, to coat 

Devilled Eggs with Five Chilli Oil 
2 eggs, hard boiled
1 tbsp  of @boombayway’s Vegan Garlic Mayo
1 tsp of @boombayway’s Five Chilli Oil
salt + pepper, to taste
coriander to garnish
